files.html: //! examples/geno_lab - the training lab: a run's policy, shown on Geno. //! //! A training run is a folder (`tools/geno_trainer.zig`): its parameters in `run.zon`, its newest weights and its //! newest policy, beside them their checkpoints, its log and its status. The lab lists the run folders in `runs`, //! beside its own executable. A run chosen there is loaded - its parameters, for the task, and its policy file - and //! shown: Geno on the floor following the dance, each decision the policy's mean action through DReCon's filter //! (`robot_lab.PolicyShow`), with the reference beside him. No learner is loaded to watch a run, so every learner's //! run is watched this one way. A click on the learning curves shows the policy checkpoint nearest that minute; while //! the trainer runs, "reload" puts its newest policy in place of the one shown, and the character goes on. //! //! The lab starts trainers too, beside its own executable: on a new run from its form, or again on a run that ended - //! "resume", the trainer carrying on from the folder's weights and log - and asks one to stop through its `stop` file. //! A trainer keeps running when the lab closes. //! //! Run folders are files by path, which a page does not have: in a web build the list is left out. const std = @import("std"); const builtin = @import("builtin"); const z = @import("zimr"); const zm = @import("zm"); const ui = z.ui; const rbt = z.robot; const rmj = z.robot_mjcf; const mjcf = z.mjcf; const codecs = z.codecs; const dance = z.robot_dance; const ppo_track = z.robot_ppo_track; const track = z.robot_track; const geno = z.robot_geno; const lab = z.robot_lab; const native_os = z.native_os; const Allocator = std.mem.Allocator; const ArenaAllocator = std.heap.ArenaAllocator; const ArrayList = std.ArrayList; const Io = std.Io; const Vec = zm.Vec; const Mat = zm.Mat; const Quat = zm.Quat; const Color = zm.Color; const Camera3D = zm.Camera3D; const vec = zm.vec; const qmul = zm.qmul; const quatToMat = zm.quatToMat; const mulMat = zm.mulMat; const translation = zm.translation; const scaling = zm.scaling; const splat = zm.splat; const clamp = zm.clamp; const log10 = zm.log10; const bufPrint = std.fmt.bufPrint; const lessThan = std.mem.lessThan; const sortSlice = std.mem.sort; const eql = std.mem.eql; const splitScalar = std.mem.splitScalar; const isAlphanumeric = std.ascii.isAlphanumeric; const is_browser: bool = z.host.is_browser; const log = std.log.scoped(.lab); const dance_zclip = @embedFile("geno_dance_zclip"); const roboto_mono_ttf = @embedFile("roboto_mono_ttf"); /// The lab's colours: the background, the character, the reference, the floor. const Look = struct { background: Color = .{ .r = 22, .g = 24, .b = 30, .a = 255 }, character: Color = .{ .r = 120, .g = 170, .b = 225, .a = 255 }, reference: Color = .{ .r = 86, .g = 92, .b = 104, .a = 255 }, floor: Color = .{ .r = 74, .g = 80, .b = 92, .a = 255 }, /// What stops a new run from starting, in its form. problem: Color = .{ .r = 235, .g = 120, .b = 110, .a = 255 }, /// The runs' colours on the curves, in the list's order, round again after the last. runs: [6]Color = .{ .{ .r = 120, .g = 170, .b = 225, .a = 255 }, .{ .r = 230, .g = 160, .b = 80, .a = 255 }, .{ .r = 130, .g = 200, .b = 120, .a = 255 }, .{ .r = 220, .g = 110, .b = 130, .a = 255 }, .{ .r = 190, .g = 150, .b = 220, .a = 255 }, .{ .r = 220, .g = 210, .b = 120, .a = 255 }, }, fn runColor(look: Look, run_index: usize) Color { return look.runs[run_index % look.runs.len]; } }; /// How often the runs' logs and statuses are read again: the trainer rewrites them every few minutes, so a few /// seconds is often enough to see a new save soon after it lands. const CurvesRefresh = struct { interval_seconds: f32 = 5, }; /// The curves' plot: the time to failure from 1 s to 60 s on a logarithmic scale, where a policy's progress from /// the servo's seconds to a minute takes equal room per tenfold; the marked values; the frame's height. const CurvePlot = struct { lowest_seconds: f32 = 1, highest_seconds: f32 = 60, marks: [4]f32 = .{ 1, 5, 20, 60 }, height: f32 = 180, /// The shortest x range, in minutes: a run's first minutes fill the plot rather than a sliver at its left. least_minutes: f32 = 0.1, }; /// The floor's slab, as drawn: square, of some thickness, its top just below the grid - where the physics floor /// is, as near as the grid's lines allow without the two fighting for the same pixels. const Floor = struct { side: f32 = 16, thickness: f32 = 0.2, top: f32 = -0.005, }; /// The new training's form (`drawNewRunWindow`): the run's parameters as its `run.zon` will hold them, the name of /// its folder, and whether the form is open. const NewRunForm = struct { is_open: bool = false, run: lab.PpoRun = .{}, name_buffer: [64]u8 = @splat(0), name_length: usize = 0, fn name(form: *const NewRunForm) []const u8 { return form.name_buffer[0..form.name_length]; } }; /// A trainer this lab started (`startRun`, `resumeRun`): its run's folder name and the program. The program's watcher /// thread keeps the program's address, so a started trainer never moves: `State.started` is a fixed array, and a slot /// is taken again only once its trainer has ended. const StartedTrainer = struct { run_name: z.Str(name_capacity) = .{}, program: native_os.ChildProgram = .{}, /// The program's state when the console was last told it (`watchStartedTrainers`): each change is told once. told_state: native_os.ChildState = .idle, /// How many trainers one lab starts and watches at once. const most: usize = 8; /// The longest run name a slot holds, in bytes: the new-run form's longest (`NewRunForm.name_buffer`). const name_capacity: usize = 64; fn isRunning(started: *const StartedTrainer) bool { return started.program.currentState() == .running; } }; // ---- Run folders ---- /// The folder the lab finds runs in: `runs`, beside its own executable, written into `buffer`. fn runsFolder(io: Io, buffer: []u8) ?[]const u8 { var executable_buffer: [1024]u8 = undefined; const executable_folder: []const u8 = native_os.executableFolder(io, &executable_buffer) orelse return null; return bufPrint(buffer, "{s}/runs", .{executable_folder}) catch null; } /// The path of `name` in `folder`, written into `buffer`. fn pathIn(folder: []const u8, name: []const u8, buffer: []u8) ?[]const u8 { return bufPrint(buffer, "{s}/{s}", .{ folder, name }) catch null; } /// The run folders in `runs_folder`, by name: its folders, without its files. Free the list with /// `native_os.freeFolderEntries`. fn listRuns(gpa: Allocator, io: Io, runs_folder: []const u8) ![]native_os.FolderEntry { const entries: []native_os.FolderEntry = try native_os.listFolder(gpa, io, runs_folder); var folder_count: usize = 0; for (entries) |entry| { if (entry.kind == .folder) { entries[folder_count] = entry; folder_count += 1; } else { gpa.free(entry.name); } } const runs: []native_os.FolderEntry = try gpa.realloc(entries, folder_count); sortSlice(native_os.FolderEntry, runs, {}, struct { fn byName(_: void, a: native_os.FolderEntry, b: native_os.FolderEntry) bool { return lessThan(u8, a.name, b.name); } }.byName); return runs; } /// The trainer's executable (`tools/geno_trainer.zig`), beside the lab's own - where the lab's build installs it -, /// written into `buffer`. fn trainerPath(io: Io, buffer: []u8) ?[]const u8 { var executable_buffer: [1024]u8 = undefined; const executable_folder: []const u8 = native_os.executableFolder(io, &executable_buffer) orelse return null; const trainer_file_name: []const u8 = if (builtin.os.tag == .windows) "geno_trainer.exe" else "geno_trainer"; return pathIn(executable_folder, trainer_file_name, buffer); } /// The index of the run named `name` in `runs`, or null when none has that name. fn runIndexNamed(runs: []const native_os.FolderEntry, name: []const u8) ?usize { for (runs, 0..) |run, index| { if (eql(u8, run.name, name)) { return index; } } return null; } /// Whether `name` can name a run's folder: not empty, and only letters, digits, '-' and '_' - nothing a path reads /// as a separator or as a folder above. fn isRunNameFit(name: []const u8) bool { if (name.len == 0) { return false; } for (name) |character| { const is_letter_or_digit: bool = isAlphanumeric(character); const is_dash_or_underscore: bool = character == '-' or character == '_'; if (!is_letter_or_digit and !is_dash_or_underscore) { return false; } } return true; } /// A name no listed run has, for a new run of `motion`: its label and the first free number - `dance-1`, /// `dance-2` - written into `buffer`. fn freeRunName( runs: []const native_os.FolderEntry, motion: lab.PpoMotion, buffer: []u8, ) []const u8 { var number: u32 = 1; while (true) : (number += 1) { const name: []const u8 = bufPrint(buffer, "{s}-{d}", .{ motion.label(), number }) catch return ""; const is_taken: bool = runIndexNamed(runs, name) != null; if (!is_taken) { return name; } } } /// A run's parameters, from the `run.zon` in `run_folder` (`lab.GenoRun`, which reads the older `PpoRun` too). /// Memory: the file's text and the parser's work freed before it returns; the run is plain values. fn readRunParameters(gpa: Allocator, io: Io, run_folder: []const u8) !lab.GenoRun { var path_buffer: [1200]u8 = undefined; const run_file_name: []const u8 = lab.RunFile.parameters.fileName(); const run_path: []const u8 = pathIn(run_folder, run_file_name, &path_buffer) orelse return error.NameTooLong; const source: []u8 = try native_os.readWhole(gpa, io, run_path, lab.RunFile.most_bytes) orelse return error.NoRunFile; defer gpa.free(source); var arena_state: ArenaAllocator = .init(gpa); defer arena_state.deinit(); const arena: Allocator = arena_state.allocator(); const terminated_source: [:0]const u8 = try arena.dupeSentinel(u8, source, 0); var failure: lab.GenoRun.ParseFailure = .{ .description = "" }; return lab.GenoRun.parse(gpa, arena, terminated_source, &failure); } /// Reads the policy file `policy_name` in `run_folder` - the newest policy, or a checkpoint of it (`lab.PolicyFile`). /// A folder without one - a run from before policy files, or one that has not saved yet - is `error.NoPolicyFile`. /// Memory: the policy's arrays are allocated with `gpa` and are the caller's to `deinit`; the file's bytes are freed /// before it returns. fn readPolicy( gpa: Allocator, io: Io, run_folder: []const u8, policy_name: []const u8, ) !lab.GenoPolicy { var path_buffer: [1200]u8 = undefined; const policy_path: []const u8 = pathIn(run_folder, policy_name, &path_buffer) orelse return error.NameTooLong; const policy_bytes: []u8 = try native_os.readWhole(gpa, io, policy_path, lab.RunFile.most_bytes) orelse return error.NoPolicyFile; defer gpa.free(policy_bytes); return lab.PolicyFile.decode(gpa, policy_bytes); } /// The policy file in `run_folder` nearest `minute` of training: the checkpoint whose minute is nearest, when the /// folder keeps any; else the newest policy. Written into `name_buffer`. Memory: the folder's listing is freed before /// it returns. fn policyNearest( gpa: Allocator, io: Io, run_folder: []const u8, minute: u64, name_buffer: *lab.RunFile.NameBuffer, ) ![]const u8 { const newest_name: []const u8 = lab.RunFile.policy_name; const entries: []native_os.FolderEntry = try native_os.listFolder(gpa, io, run_folder); defer native_os.freeFolderEntries(gpa, entries); var nearest_minute: ?u64 = null; var nearest_distance: u64 = 0; for (entries) |entry| { const checkpoint_minute: u64 = lab.RunFile.policyCheckpointMinute(entry.name) orelse continue; const is_after: bool = checkpoint_minute > minute; const minute_distance: u64 = if (is_after) checkpoint_minute - minute else minute - checkpoint_minute; const is_nearer: bool = nearest_minute == null or minute_distance < nearest_distance; if (is_nearer) { nearest_distance = minute_distance; nearest_minute = checkpoint_minute; } } const chosen_minute: u64 = nearest_minute orelse return newest_name; return lab.RunFile.policyCheckpointName(chosen_minute, name_buffer); } // ---- The runs watched ---- /// A run's judgements as the lab shows them (`lab.JudgeLog`): the servo alone, and the newest policy with the minute /// of training it was judged at - both on the same fixed starts, so the one is the other's baseline. const JudgedRun = struct { servo: track.Judgement, newest: track.Judgement, newest_minutes: f32, }; /// The servo's judgement and the newest one in `judge.csv`'s text: its first line of batch zero, and its last line of /// any later batch; null until the file holds both. fn judgedRunOf(judgements_text: []const u8) ?JudgedRun { var servo: ?track.Judgement = null; var newest: ?lab.JudgeLog.Line = null; var lines: std.mem.SplitIterator(u8, .scalar) = splitScalar(u8, judgements_text, '\n'); while (lines.next()) |line_text| { const line: lab.JudgeLog.Line = lab.JudgeLog.parseLine(line_text) orelse continue; if (line.batch == 0) { if (servo == null) { servo = line.judgement; } } else { newest = line; } } const servo_judgement: track.Judgement = servo orelse return null; const newest_line: lab.JudgeLog.Line = newest orelse return null; const judged: JudgedRun = .{ .servo = servo_judgement, .newest = newest_line.judgement, .newest_minutes = newest_line.training_minutes, }; return judged; } /// A run as the lab watches it: its learning curve, read from its log as it grows, the points the plot draws, its /// status as last read, and its newest judgement beside the servo's. const RunWatch = struct { curve: lab.RunCurve = .{}, /// The curve's points as the plot takes them: training minutes, and the time to failure - a window in which /// nothing failed drawn at the plot's top. xs: ArrayList(f32) = .empty, ys: ArrayList(f32) = .empty, status: ?lab.RunStatus = null, judged: ?JudgedRun = null, /// The run's save interval (`GenoControls.save_minutes`), read from its `run.zon` once: what silence is judged by. save_minutes: ?f32 = null, fn deinit(watch: *RunWatch, gpa: Allocator) void { watch.curve.deinit(gpa); watch.xs.deinit(gpa); watch.ys.deinit(gpa); } /// Whether the run's trainer has gone silent (`RunStatus.isSilent`). Silence is judged by the run's save interval, /// so never for a run with no status yet, or whose `run.zon` could not be read. fn isSilent(watch: *const RunWatch, now_seconds: i64) bool { const status: lab.RunStatus = watch.status orelse return false; const save_minutes: f32 = watch.save_minutes orelse return false; return status.isSilent(now_seconds, save_minutes); } }; /// Reads the run in `run_folder` again: its log's new lines into its curve, the plot's points from the curve, its /// judgements, and its status. A file that cannot be read leaves what was read before. Memory: every file's text is /// read with `gpa` and freed before it returns; the curve's and the plot's points grow with `gpa`, as `watch`'s. fn readRunWatch( gpa: Allocator, io: Io, run_folder: []const u8, physics_steps_per_second: f32, plot: CurvePlot, watch: *RunWatch, ) !void { var path_buffer: [1200]u8 = undefined; const log_name: []const u8 = lab.RunFile.log.fileName(); const log_path: []const u8 = pathIn(run_folder, log_name, &path_buffer) orelse return; if (try native_os.readWhole(gpa, io, log_path, lab.RunFile.most_bytes)) |log_text| { defer gpa.free(log_text); try watch.curve.readMore(gpa, log_text, physics_steps_per_second); } watch.xs.clearRetainingCapacity(); watch.ys.clearRetainingCapacity(); for (watch.curve.points.items) |point| { const seconds_drawn: f32 = point.seconds_to_failure orelse plot.highest_seconds; try watch.xs.append(gpa, point.training_minutes); try watch.ys.append(gpa, seconds_drawn); } const judgements_name: []const u8 = lab.RunFile.judgements.fileName(); if (pathIn(run_folder, judgements_name, &path_buffer)) |judgements_path| { if (try native_os.readWhole(gpa, io, judgements_path, lab.RunFile.most_bytes)) |judgements_text| { defer gpa.free(judgements_text); watch.judged = judgedRunOf(judgements_text) orelse watch.judged; } } const status_name: []const u8 = lab.RunFile.status.fileName(); const status_path: []const u8 = pathIn(run_folder, status_name, &path_buffer) orelse return; const status_text: []u8 = try native_os.readWhole(gpa, io, status_path, lab.RunFile.most_bytes) orelse return; defer gpa.free(status_text); var arena_state: ArenaAllocator = .init(gpa); defer arena_state.deinit(); const arena: Allocator = arena_state.allocator(); const terminated_status: [:0]const u8 = try arena.dupeSentinel(u8, status_text, 0); if (lab.RunStatus.parse(gpa, arena, terminated_status)) |status| { watch.status = status; } if (watch.save_minutes == null) { const parameters: ?lab.GenoRun = readRunParameters(gpa, io, run_folder) catch null; watch.save_minutes = if (parameters) |known| known.controls.save_minutes else null; } } // ---- The run shown ---- /// A run loaded and shown: its policy (`lab.GenoPolicy`, the run's newest or one of its checkpoints) and one /// character living what the policy does (`lab.PolicyShow`) - no learner is loaded, so every learner's run is watched /// this one way - on the show's own clock. With them, the run's parameters (the new-run form starts from them), the /// policy file's name, and the run's folder name, its own copy, so that reloading reads the same run whatever the list /// holds by then. /// /// Memory: the show lives in `show_arena`, on the heap so that the arena stays where its allocator points when the /// struct moves; the policy is allocated with the lab's `gpa`, so that a newer policy can take its place while the /// character goes on (`reloadShownRun`). const ShownRun = struct { parameters: lab.GenoRun, show_arena: *ArenaAllocator, policy: lab.GenoPolicy, show: lab.PolicyShow, /// Real time, as the show's physics steps (`stepShowForFrame`): started afresh with each run shown. clock: ppo_track.ShowClock, policy_name_buffer: lab.RunFile.NameBuffer, policy_name_length: usize, name_buffer: [256]u8, name_length: usize, fn name(self: *const ShownRun) []const u8 { return self.name_buffer[0..self.name_length]; } /// The policy file shown: `policy`, or a checkpoint's `policy_m<minute>`. fn policyName(self: *const ShownRun) []const u8 { return self.policy_name_buffer[0..self.policy_name_length]; } }; /// Loads the run in `run_folder`: its parameters - for the task the policy is shown on, its decision's length, its /// filter's bodies - its policy file `policy_name`, and a show of one character. Memory: as `ShownRun` says; release /// with `unloadRun`. fn loadRun( gpa: Allocator, io: Io, imported: *rmj.Imported, clip: *const dance.Clip, run_folder: []const u8, policy_name: []const u8, ) !ShownRun { const parameters: lab.GenoRun = try readRunParameters(gpa, io, run_folder); if (parameters.problem() != null) { return error.RunOutOfRange; } var policy: lab.GenoPolicy = try readPolicy(gpa, io, run_folder, policy_name); errdefer policy.deinit(gpa); const show_arena: *ArenaAllocator = try gpa.create(ArenaAllocator); show_arena.* = ArenaAllocator.init(gpa); errdefer { show_arena.deinit(); gpa.destroy(show_arena); } const arena: Allocator = show_arena.allocator(); // The task every learner's run is on - Geno's task, DReCon's bodies - with the learner's own decision. const settings: lab.PolicyShowSettings = lab.showSettingsFor(parameters); const clips: []*const dance.Clip = try arena.dupe(*const dance.Clip, &.{clip}); const show: lab.PolicyShow = try .start(arena, &imported.model, imported.names, clips, &policy, settings); const folder_name: []const u8 = std.fs.path.basename(run_folder); var shown: ShownRun = .{ .parameters = parameters, .show_arena = show_arena, .policy = policy, .show = show, .clock = .{}, .policy_name_buffer = undefined, .policy_name_length = @min(policy_name.len, lab.RunFile.name_capacity), .name_buffer = undefined, .name_length = @min(folder_name.len, 256), }; @memcpy(shown.policy_name_buffer[0..shown.policy_name_length], policy_name[0..shown.policy_name_length]); @memcpy(shown.name_buffer[0..shown.name_length], folder_name[0..shown.name_length]); return shown; } /// Releases a shown run: its show and the arena it lives in, then its policy. fn unloadRun(gpa: Allocator, shown: *ShownRun) void { shown.show.end(); shown.show_arena.deinit(); gpa.destroy(shown.show_arena); shown.policy.deinit(gpa); } // ---- Drawing ---- /// The meshes every geom is drawn with, scaled to its size. const Meshes = struct { sphere: z.Mesh, cube: z.Mesh, cylinder: z.Mesh, }; /// A point of the robot's world, where z is up, in the drawing's, where y is up: the quarter turn about x that /// `zm.zUpToYUp` makes, (x, y, z) to (x, z, -y). fn yUpOf(z_up_point: Vec) Vec { return vec(z_up_point[0], z_up_point[2], -z_up_point[1]); } /// The robot in `data`, every geom at its body's place, tinted `tint`. fn drawRobot( gl: *z.WgpuGl, model: *const rbt.Model, meshes: *Meshes, transform: *[1]Mat, data: *const rbt.Data, tint: Color, ) void { const to_y_up: Mat = zm.zUpToYUp(); for (0..model.ngeom) |geom| { const body: u32 = model.geom_body[geom]; const body_position: Vec = data.body_xpos[body]; const body_rotation: Quat = data.body_xrot[body]; // The geom in the world: its offset from its body, turned with the body; its rotation, after the body's. const offset_in_world: Vec = zm.rotate(body_rotation, model.geom_pos[geom]); const world_position: Vec = body_position + offset_in_world; const world_quaternion: Quat = qmul(body_rotation, model.geom_rot[geom]); const world_rotation: Mat = quatToMat(world_quaternion); // The same place in the drawing, where y is up. const world_translation: Mat = translation(world_position[0], world_position[1], world_position[2]); const translation_drawn: Mat = mulMat(to_y_up, world_translation); const place: Mat = mulMat(translation_drawn, world_rotation); switch (model.geom_shape[geom]) { .sphere => |sphere| { const radius: f32 = sphere.radius; transform[0] = mulMat(place, scaling(radius, radius, radius)); z.drawMeshInstanced(gl, &meshes.sphere, transform, tint); }, .box => |box| { const size: Vec = box.half_extent * splat(2.0); transform[0] = mulMat(place, scaling(size[0], size[1], size[2])); z.drawMeshInstanced(gl, &meshes.cube, transform, tint); }, .capsule => |capsule| { // The cylinder mesh rises from its base: its base moved down half the capsule's length, then the // mesh stretched to the capsule's radius and whole length. const capsule_length: f32 = 2.0 * capsule.half_height; const base_lowered: Mat = mulMat(place, translation(0, -capsule.half_height, 0)); transform[0] = mulMat(base_lowered, scaling(capsule.radius, capsule_length, capsule.radius)); z.drawMeshInstanced(gl, &meshes.cylinder, transform, tint); }, else => {}, } } } /// Steps the show through the physics steps its clock gives the frame (`ppo_track.ShowClock`): real time at any frame /// rate and never faster, and slow motion rather than longer steps on a device that cannot keep up. fn stepShowForFrame( show: *lab.PolicyShow, policy: *const lab.GenoPolicy, clock: *ppo_track.ShowClock, timestep: f32, dt: f32, ) void { const steps_to_take: u32 = clock.stepsForFrame(dt, timestep); for (0..steps_to_take) |_| { show.step(policy); } } /// The floor's slab: the unit cube's center half its thickness below the top, then the cube stretched to the slab. fn drawFloor( gl: *z.WgpuGl, cube: *z.Mesh, transform: *[1]Mat, floor: Floor, tint: Color, ) void { const center_height: f32 = floor.top - 0.5 * floor.thickness; const center: Mat = mulMat(zm.zUpToYUp(), translation(0, 0, center_height)); transform[0] = mulMat(center, scaling(floor.side, floor.side, floor.thickness)); z.drawMeshInstanced(gl, cube, transform, tint); } // ---- The app ---- const State = struct { gpa: Allocator, font: z.Font, ui_host: z.UiHost, cam: z.OrbitCamera, meshes: Meshes, transform: [1]Mat, document: codecs.xml.Document, robot: mjcf.Robot, imported: rmj.Imported, clip: dance.Clip, /// The reference pose, posed from the clip at the shown character's frame. ghost: rbt.Data, runs_folder_buffer: [1024]u8, runs_folder_length: usize, runs: []native_os.FolderEntry, /// One per run of `runs`, in its order. watches: []RunWatch, curves_refresh: CurvesRefresh, curve_plot: CurvePlot, /// Seconds since the runs were last read (`readRunWatch`). since_runs_read_seconds: f32, selected_run: ?usize, shown: ?ShownRun, status: z.Str(160), look: Look, floor: Floor, new_run: NewRunForm, started: [StartedTrainer.most]StartedTrainer, }; fn runsFolderOf(s: *const State) []const u8 { return s.runs_folder_buffer[0..s.runs_folder_length]; } /// Says what the lab just did, or why it could not: on the panel's status line, and as a line on the console the /// lab was started from. fn tell( s: *State, comptime level: std.log.Level, comptime format: []const u8, arguments: anytype, ) void { s.status = .print(format, arguments); switch (level) { .err => log.err(format, arguments), .warn => log.warn(format, arguments), .info, .debug => log.info(format, arguments), } } /// Reads every watched run again (`readRunWatch`). fn readRuns(s: *State, io: Io) void { const physics_steps_per_second: f32 = 1.0 / s.imported.model.opt.timestep; for (s.runs, s.watches) |run, *watch| { var path_buffer: [1200]u8 = undefined; const run_folder: []const u8 = pathIn(runsFolderOf(s), run.name, &path_buffer) orelse continue; readRunWatch(s.gpa, io, run_folder, physics_steps_per_second, s.curve_plot, watch) catch |err| { s.status = .print("{s}: {s}", .{ run.name, @errorName(err) }); }; } s.since_runs_read_seconds = 0; } /// The run folders listed again from the runs folder; the shown run found again in the new list, by name - or no /// run selected, when its folder has gone. fn refreshRuns(s: *State, io: Io) void { for (s.watches) |*watch| { watch.deinit(s.gpa);
